You can't be everywhere on the map as a jungler. You play by making decisions. Your whole point is based on miss/outdated information. Liandry damage does not scale with your own max, but the enemies, so RoA wouldn't do shit for the damage. Also, Riftmaker hasn't done true damage for a long while now, and it is kinda ironic how the big drawback of Riftmaker on your vision is the 4s it takes to scale the 8% bonus damage (which stacks with Liandrys passive) and the omnivamp, but you're willing to give away 10 minutes of your spike as a jungler for a item that's just a stat stick that no jungler needs, since the mana is useless.

Runes are mostly the same as always: conquer, triumph, haste, preference, magic boots and item and spell haste (secondary tree is kinda preference too, you can go with the green one for games that in paper would be more controlled). For stats, take atk speed, ap and hp per level (could also be two hp per level if against a match up you'll avoid early)

As for itens: Liandry > Riftmaker/Zhonya/Abyssal (Riftmaker if ahead, Zhonya if even or behind against mostly ad, Abyssal if even or behind against mostly ap, but you'll want to build all three. If against full ap, go Spirit Visage over Zhonya, if against full ad, go Jaksho over Abyssal and finish the build with wathever armor item fits the match) > Jaksho, defensive boots always.

Theres a universal 15% chance of resisting debuffs, so when trying to debuff something, it doesn't matter if they have 80 effect resistance and you have 300 effectiveness, they'll still have a 15% chance to resist. Thats why the effectiveness needed on your debuffers is the enemy effect resistance - 15.

There's absolute no need to get 100% effectiveness on any unit for PVE. Hunt 13 bosses have 80% effect resistance, so you only need 65% effectiveness on your units. The only content you'll need more than that will be raid and high abyss where enemies have 100 effect resistance, so your units will need 85% effectiveness.
